description: This file contains the implementation of a generic durable task completion source in the Orleans framework, including the interface IDurableTaskCompletionSource<T>, the internal class DurableTaskCompletionSource<T>, and related supporting types. It manages asynchronous task completion, persistence, recovery, and state management for durable tasks.

classes.name: DurableTaskCompletionSource<T>
classes.description: Internal sealed class implementing durable task completion logic, state management, persistence, recovery, and continuation handling within Orleans.

methods.name: TrySetResult
methods.description: Attempts to set the result value of the task if the current state is pending.

methods.name: TrySetException
methods.description: Attempts to set an exception as the task outcome if the current state is pending.

methods.name: TrySetCanceled
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the task if the current state is pending.

methods.name: OnValuePersisted
methods.description: Completes the associated task with the current state, called after persistence or recovery.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine for reuse, assigning new storage.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a logged entry to restore the state during recovery, reading from storage.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends change entries to storage if not pending.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Stores a snapshot of the current state.

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes the state into storage or snapshot.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Not implemented; placeholder for deep copying the state machine.

methods.name: TrySetResult
methods.description: Attempts to complete the task successfully with a given value.

methods.name: TrySetException
methods.description: Attempts to complete the task with an exception.

methods.name: OnValuePersisted
methods.description: Triggers continuation completion based on current state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal state and assigns a storage writer.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Reads a log entry and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends state changes to the log.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of the current state.

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes the current state to storage or snapshot.
